statement: Consider the weights of Section 2, with rδ/δ → m/2, on isoradial meshes whose rhombus half-angles belong to [η, π/2 − η]. 1. For marked Carathéodory convergence to a bounded simply connected two-point domain, the reconstructed two-point FK fermion converges locally uniformly, up to its common sign, to a smooth massive-holomorphic function f: ¯ ∂f + imf = 0. Its square integral h, normalized by its two boundary values, is the unique bounded solution ∆h = −4m|∇h|, h = 1 on the wired bank, h = 0 on the dual-wired bank. The boundary values are prime-end limits away from the two marked ends, and 0 ≤ h ≤ 1. The convergence includes uniform interior bounds on protected compact subsets. 2. For every fixed rectangle aspect ratio and every finite physical scale bound, the crossing prob- abilities of both colors are bounded away from zero, uniformly over all boundary conditions and all nondegenerate lattice rectangles below that scale whose side lengths exceed a fixed multiple of the mesh. The scale constants are independent of the mesh.
